name: Library docs assistant
author: Example publisher
description: Combines a skill with a Context7 connection to look up versioned documentation. Service quota and credentials are managed by the provider.

skills.name: Library docs lookup
skills.description: Use when the user asks about a library's or framework's API, usage or version changes.
skills.instructions: First confirm the library and version, then use the confirmed Context7 tools to resolve the library identifier and query the relevant documentation. External calls wait for authorization. Answer from the material actually returned and state the version; if the connection is unavailable, say so and never invent lookup results.

credentials.description: Optional: Bearer followed by your Context7 API key.
